title: Lior and the Interior
author: Tamsin Nystrom
blurb: Tamsin Blackwood, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
